CustomField.description: The product attribute category from Odoo (e.g., Draw Cap in kVA). When populated, the quote line editor shows an attribute selector for this product. Maps to Odoo Product Attribute Type.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The type of attribute this product has (e.g., Draw Cap in kVA). Drives the attribute selector on quote lines.
CustomField.label: Product Attribute Type
